chambers.name: Awakening
map: X P     XX  XX     #X               E  X
hints: A / D to move    W / SPACE to jump
Walk into the blue portal. Look closely - you can see THROUGH it.

chambers.name: Blue Sky
hints: LEFT MOUSE fires the blue portal. Portals only stick to WHITE panels.
The orange portal is fixed. Make an entrance that leads to it.

chambers.name: Two Ends
hints: RIGHT MOUSE fires orange. Enter one, exit the other.
Ceilings work too. Gravity does the rest.

chambers.name: Weighted
hints: E picks up / drops a cube. Buttons need something heavy on them.
Stand on a floor portal to drop through it.

chambers.name: Toxic
hints: Goo is lethal. Don't touch it.
Cubes come with you when you carry them through a portal.

chambers.name: Speedy Thing
hints: Speedy thing goes in, speedy thing comes out.
Fall a long way into a floor portal and you'll fly out of the other one.

chambers.name: Emancipation
map: X   P   C           |       1     a  E X
hints: Emancipation grids vaporize cubes and erase your portals.
Your portal shots pass through the grid. Cubes do not.

chambers.name: Through the Glass
hints: Lasers travel through portals - and through glass. You don't.
Aim the beam at the receiver. Where it enters a portal decides where it leaves.

chambers.name: Relay
map: # P C                   2     a   b  E X
hints: One pair of portals. Several jobs. Do them in the right order.
First get past the beam. Then put the beam to work.

chambers.name: Ascension
hints: A floor portal can launch you UP. The further you fall, the higher you fly.
Steer in mid-air with A / D.

chambers.name: Up and Over
hints: The cube is across the goo. Go get it - and bring it back.
The exit is up high, behind the door.

chambers.name: Spring Loaded
hints: Blue gel bounces you. The harder you land, the higher you go.
Fall from far enough and the gel will throw you onto the ledge.

chambers.name: Two Weights
hints: The door needs BOTH buttons held down.
One cube is easy. The other one is up on the shelf.

chambers.name: Gel Pit
hints: You can't stand on gel - but you can use it to get across.
Keep moving while you bounce.

chambers.name: Umbrella
hints: Lasers can't get through cubes.
Hold the cube above your head and walk under the beams.

chambers.name: Twin Beams
hints: Both receivers must be lit.
One portal pair can carry two beams at once - if you line it up.

chambers.name: Grid Lock
map: X  P  C     |                 1   a  E X
hints: The grid eats cubes. The beam eats you.
Get the cube across both - in one piece.

chambers.name: Skylight
hints: This beam points straight up.
Catch it in the ceiling and send it sideways.

chambers.name: Overpass
hints: The gap is wider now. Fall further, fly further.
Flying through the grid wipes your portals - after you've used them.

chambers.name: Bounce House
hints: The button is up on the ledge. So is the exit.
Cubes don't bounce while you hold them. You still do.

chambers.name: Midterm
hints: Everything you've learned. Three rooms. One way out.
Remember: portal shots pass through emancipation grids.

chambers.name: Stool Pigeon
hints: That ledge is just out of reach. Cubes make a decent step.
Put the cube against the wall, climb on, then jump again.

chambers.name: Pinball
hints: Orange plates throw you. Left or right, depending on the arrow.
Keep holding a direction while you fly.

chambers.name: Launch Pad
hints: Orange gel makes you fast. Fast enough to clear the goo.
The next plate does the rest.

chambers.name: Trampoline Park
hints: Blue gel bounces you. Land on it and you go right back up.
Hold a direction and keep landing on the pads.

chambers.name: Peephole
map: X P              XXX          X     E  X
hints: The wall is solid, but the window isn't. Portal shots fly right through it.
Put an exit where you can see it, not where you can stand.

chambers.name: Stepping Stones
hints: The goo is too wide to jump. The ceiling is not too far to shoot.
Enter the floor portal, fall out of the ceiling onto the next stone.
Each stone needs a fresh pair.

chambers.name: Catapult
map: X P  C                           a   E X
hints: Launch plates throw anything that lands on them. Anything.
Mind the plate yourself - it doesn't care who steps on it.

chambers.name: Moat
hints: Fetch the cube from the island. Then get it back across.
Cubes ride portals just like you do.

chambers.name: Hold the Door
map: X P C  T              a     2     b     E  X
hints: The button only holds the door for a few seconds.
The next door wants something heavy. Don't leave it behind.

chambers.name: Rush Hour
map: X P T          a                a                        E X
hints: The button only holds the doors open for a few seconds after you step off it.
Orange gel is fast. Fast enough to make the next door.

chambers.name: Safe Cracker
map: X PT                  T  a     E       X
hints: All three buttons have to be down at once. Each one only lasts a few seconds.
Plates are faster than stairs.

chambers.name: Disarmed
map: X P     C         XX    1         a  E X
hints: No gun this time. The portals are already there.
That plate throws you at the wall. Take the cube along.

chambers.name: Jailbreak
map: X  E        a           1   XP  CX     X
hints: You are locked in. The orange portal isn't.
Whatever is in the cell with you can come out too.

chambers.name: Bank Shot
hints: The cube with the mirror in it bends beams. This one is yours to place.
Riding a launch plate with a cube in your hands is allowed.

chambers.name: Spotlight
hints: The beam can't get through the wall. A portal can.
Put the other end where it will do some good - and where you can see it.

chambers.name: Double Decker
hints: The ceiling upstairs is out of reach. It isn't out of sight.
Gravity works both ways through that hole. The button is downstairs.

chambers.name: Fizzler Row
hints: The grid eats cubes. The goo eats everything else.
You can shoot through a grid. Just don't touch it.

chambers.name: Ascent
hints: Up, and up, and up. Nothing here is the same twice.
A cube is a step. A plate is a throw. Gel is a spring.

chambers.name: Terminal Velocity
hints: The goo is too wide for that fall. Falling faster is a matter of falling further.
Portals don't care which way is up. Make the shaft longer.
